name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, Central Financial Assistance (CFA)
source: Benefits section of the home page of the National Portal for Rooftop Solar (Ministry of New and Renewable Energy), as read on 2026-10-07.

rules.statedAs: Rs. 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW; Rs. 18,000 per kW for additional capacity up to 3 kW; Rs. 78,000 total subsidy for systems larger than 3 kW (capped at).
conditions: Households only: the page states this as the subsidy for residential households.
Paid through the national portal after an approved installation by a registered vendor and DISCOM inspection; this tool does not check any of that.
notes: The portal's notice list shows a '2nd amendment in the Guidelines of PM-Surya Ghar for the component CFA to Residential Consumers' dated 31 Aug. The text of that amendment was not read; if it changes these figures, update this file.
The page also says that for 'special states' an additional 10% subsidy per kW applies. It does not say which states, so that uplift is NOT applied.
Whether batteries are covered is not stated on the page read; this tool treats the subsidy as applying to the solar system only.

rules.description: Subsidy for Group Housing Societies and Resident Welfare Associations, for common facilities including EV charging.
rules.statedAs: Rs. 18,000 per kW for common facilities, including EV charging, up to 500 kW capacity (@3 kW per house) with the upper limit being inclusive of individual rooftop plants installed by individual residents in the GHS/RWA.

notApplied: Additional 10% subsidy per kW for 'special states' (the states are not listed on the page read).
Table of suitable rooftop capacity by monthly consumption (the heading was seen, the values were not read).
